Hi,

What should I be working on this week so my 4th attempt gets approved?

Thank you,
Jordan

attachment.heading: Attached Email: OA Attempt 2 MAP (Sent Sep 12, 2026)
attachment.content:
Hi Jordan,
Thank you for meeting with me today. Here is your Attempt 2 Study Plan:
1. Re-read Chapter 4 (DDL & DML Syntax) and Chapter 5 (JOINs & Views) in zyBooks.
2. Score 80% or higher on the Chapter 4 and Chapter 5 End-of-Chapter Quizzes.
3. Retake the Pre-Assessment to verify readiness before scheduling Attempt 2.

crmNotes.author: M. Chen (Primary CI)
crmNotes.title: OA Attempt 2 Approval
crmNotes.body: Verified Jordan completed the Chapter 4 and Chapter 5 reading and scored 80% on both chapter quizzes, plus scored Competent across all areas on the Pre-Assessment. Approved OA Attempt 2.

crmNotes.author: M. Chen (Primary CI)
crmNotes.title: OA Attempt 3 Intake Call & MAP Assigned
crmNotes.body: Spoke with Jordan following OA Attempt 2. Student was frustrated that the OA questions do not match the Pre-Assessment. Reviewed PA history together: Jordan has taken the PA 5 times, passing the last 3 with near-perfect scores in under 30 minutes. Diagnosed PA memorization. Assigned Attempt 3 MAP below.

attachment.heading: Attached Email: OA Attempt 3 MAP (Sent Oct 5, 2026)
attachment.content:
Hi Jordan,
Because you have seen the Pre-Assessment questions several times, we want to shift away from the PA and focus on hands-on practice and new questions for Attempt 3:
1. Attend the Live SQL Cohort session.
2. Complete the Chapter 4 zyBooks Labs (6 of 8 labs).
3. Complete the comprehensive 90-Question Challenge Quiz (closed-note diagnostic) with a score of 85% or higher.
4. Schedule a 45-minute readiness review call with me after submitting the 90-Question Challenge Quiz so we can review the concepts together before unlocking Attempt 3.

crmNotes.author: M. Chen (Primary CI)
crmNotes.title: Attempt 3 Readiness Review Call & Approval
crmNotes.body: Met with Jordan for a 45-minute call to review the Attempt 3 study plan items and discuss topics from the 90-Question Challenge Quiz. Walked through multiple-choice concepts and worked through guided SQL syntax troubleshooting problems together where Jordan spotted and fixed issues in sample queries. Jordan was able to answer the discussion questions and complete the guided syntax checks during the session. Approved OA Attempt 3.

crmNotes.author: M. Chen (Primary CI)
crmNotes.title: OA Attempt 4 Diagnostic Call & Policy Review
crmNotes.body:
Met with Jordan for a 45-minute diagnostic screen-share call following OA Attempt 3 to evaluate how they approached the exam and where the breakdown occurred. Jordan shared that after being told they could use their notes on the 90-Question Challenge Quiz, they also found a Quizlet flashcard set online covering those concepts, which helped them score 95% and made them feel confident. They noted that our Nov 8 review call also made them feel ready, and while they knew they still needed some work on their SQL syntax, they did not expect the exam to go that poorly.

During the diagnostic check, Jordan answered the multiple-choice conceptual questions just fine. However, during the live coding portion of the call (starting from a blank query window without multiple-choice options or existing code to reference), Jordan was unable to write a basic SELECT...FROM...WHERE statement from scratch and could not identify which type of JOIN to use for a given scenario. Discussed the WGU 4th Attempt policy, explained that Attempt 4 requires Multiple Attempt Committee (ACC) approval, and let Jordan know that I am on Out-of-Office leave Nov 15 to Nov 22 so a covering CI will follow up to finalize their Attempt 4 plan.
